subtitle: Compare grocery deals
shortDescription: Track grocery prices, compare stores, and watch for better deals.
promotionalText: Compare grocery prices, plan your cart, and keep track of food at home. Pocket Cart brings everyday shopping tools together for Canadian shoppers.
fullDescription:
Make everyday grocery shopping easier with Pocket Cart.

COMPARE GROCERY PRICES
Browse available deals from supported Canadian stores, compare product prices, and review price history before you shop. Coverage and prices vary by store and date; check the retailer for final pricing and availability.

PLAN YOUR CART
Keep up to 10 different products and their quantities together in a simple shopping cart. Mark items as purchased and organize your next grocery trip.

WATCH FOR DEALS
Save unlimited products for free sale alerts, set target prices, and choose your favourite stores. Notifications are optional.

KEEP TRACK OF FOOD AT HOME
Organize your fridge and freezer by storage location, track quantities and best-before dates, and set optional expiry reminders. Food storage and expiry reminders are free and unlimited.

SHARE WITH YOUR HOUSEHOLD
Invite family members to a shared cart and food inventory so everyone can help keep shopping and food records up to date.

FIND NEARBY STORES
Explore supported stores on the map. Location permission is optional; you can also search by city or postal code.

Pocket Cart is free to download. An account is needed for synced and shared features. You can delete your account in the app. Optional support through Ko-fi does not unlock app features.
reviewNotes: PocketCart is a free grocery planning app for supported Canadian stores. Browsing grocery prices is available without an account or location permission. Each Cart allows up to 10 different products; product alerts are free and unlimited. Account features include synced Cart, fridge/freezer inventory, receipts and optional family sharing. Location, camera and notifications are optional. Food Scan and receipt reading ask for explicit confirmation before sending the selected photo to OpenAI. Manual receipt entry is available. Delete Account is under Account > Account actions > Delete Account. The optional Ko-fi support link opens a browser and does not unlock digital content or app features. Use the dedicated review account entered in App Review Information to test account features.
